display.purpose: Hero headlines only. 'Documentation that works for people.' Brygada 1918 with tight letter-spacing for editorial density.

headline.purpose: Page-level section headings ('How I got here'). Brygada 1918 at a slightly smaller scale than display.

title.purpose: Showcase titles, section headings within a page. Brygada 1918 at semibold.

body.purpose: Primary reading text at 18px with generous line-height. Figtree. Constrained to 68ch max-width.

label.purpose: Section labels (TECHNICAL WRITER, ARTIFACT, PROCESS, IMPACT), showcase tags, nav links. Figtree uppercase with tracking.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Primary easing for reveals and expanding interactions (nav underline, CTA gap).

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Secondary easing for color transitions and faster state changes.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Reserved for heavier motion if needed. Currently unused in production.

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Top-level navigation link with animated underline on hover and persistent underline on active state.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-text-muted, #7a756e); text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.01em; position: relative; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; bottom: -4px; left: 0; width: 0; height: 2px; background-color: var(--color-primary, #2b6b3f); transition: width 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--color-text, #3a3530); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #2e8050); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.name: Hero CTA
components.description: Understated call-to-action with arrow that translates on hover. Not a filled button—earns attention through copy and position.
components.html: See the work →
components.css: .ds-hero-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-primary, #2b6b3f); text-decoration: none; padding: 0.75rem 0; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-primary, #2b6b3f); transition: gap 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-hero-cta:hover { gap: 0.75rem; color: var(--color-primary-hover, #1e5530); } .ds-hero-cta-arrow { transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-hero-cta:hover .ds-hero-cta-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-hero-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #2e8050); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }

components.css: .ds-showcase-entry { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 1.5rem 2rem; align-items: baseline; padding: 2rem 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border, #ddd8d1); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: background-color 300ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-showcase-entry:hover { background-color: var(--color-primary-subtle, #ecf4ee); margin-inline: -1.5rem; padding-inline: 1.5rem; border-radius: 8px; border-color: transparent; } .ds-showcase-entry__number { font-family: 'Brygada 1918', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.25rem,1.5vw+0.5rem,1.5rem); font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-primary, #2b6b3f); min-width: 2ch; } .ds-showcase-entry__body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; } .ds-showcase-entry__title { font-family: 'Brygada 1918', Georgia, serif; font-size: clamp(1.5rem,2vw+0.5rem,2rem); font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text, #3a3530); line-height: 1.35; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-showcase-entry:hover .ds-showcase-entry__title { color: var(--color-primary, #2b6b3f); } .ds-showcase-entry__meta { font-family: Figtree, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--color-text-muted, #7a756e); } .ds-showcase-entry__arrow { font-size: clamp(1.25rem,1.5vw+0.5rem,1.5rem); color: var(--color-text-faint, #9d9890); align-self: center; transition: transform 300ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.25,1,0.5,1); } .ds-showcase-entry:hover .ds-showcase-entry__arrow { transform: translateX(6px); color: var(--color-primary, #2b6b3f); } .ds-showcase-entry:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus, #2e8050); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 8px; }

narrative.overview:
This is a portfolio that teaches by showing. It borrows from the tradition of the printed folio—carefully typeset, generously margined, structured for deep reading—but lives on the web with subtle life in its interactions. The system is restrained, warm, and unadorned. It earns its authority through structure rather than decoration, through craft rather than spectacle.

The design rejects Silicon Valley 'disruption energy,' Dribbble portfolio templates with floating browser mockups, corporate case study sites with stock photography and blue-and-white palettes, minimalist dev portfolios with terminal aesthetics, and content-creator personal brands with gradient backgrounds and emoji headings. What it embraces instead: the specific warmth of someone who genuinely cares about the people her documentation serves.

Every visual choice demonstrates the same care Mari brings to client documentation. The portfolio is the specimen.
keyCharacteristics: Grounded: rooted typography, warm neutral surfaces, no floating or lifted UI
Generous: wide margins, relaxed line-height, unhurried rhythm between sections
Warm: ivory-toned surfaces (never pure white), botanical green accents drawn from Mari's portrait, terracotta warmth in selective moments
Quiet confidence: the design doesn't shout; it invites close reading
Responsive restraint: motion exists only as scroll-triggered reveals and hover feedback—never choreographed, never gratuitous

rules.name: The No Pure Black, No Pure White Rule
rules.body: Every surface and text color carries warmth on the 80° hue axis. #000 and #fff are prohibited.

rules.name: The Fern Green Discipline Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is used exclusively for interactive affordances. Never as a background fill larger than a tag chip. Its restraint is its authority.

rules.name: The 68ch Rule
rules.body: Body text never exceeds 68 characters per line. Narrow contexts use 52ch. This is a measure-based constraint in the CSS.

rules.name: The Perfect Fourth Rule
rules.body: The type scale follows a ~1.33 ratio. Sizes step from 0.75rem through 3.75rem with fluid clamp() at larger sizes. New sizes are never invented ad-hoc.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are prohibited. If a surface needs to feel elevated, it uses tonal contrast or a 1px border. The portfolio's flatness is the visual embodiment of 'earn every element.'

dos: Do use OKLCH for all color definitions in tokens.css. Hex approximations exist only in DESIGN.md frontmatter for tooling compliance.
Do constrain all body text to --measure-body (68ch) or --measure-narrow (52ch).
Do use staggered data-delay attributes (1–4) on .reveal elements to create gentle entrance choreography.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion unconditionally. All durations collapse to 0ms.
Do use aria-current="page" on the active nav link.
Do use the existing type scale from tokens.css. No ad-hoc sizes.
Do use 1px solid --color-border as the only separator between sections.
Do test all new pages at both file:// protocol and served via HTTP.
donts: Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#fff) anywhere.
Don't add box-shadows. The system is deliberately flat with tonal layering only.
Don't use gradient backgrounds, glassmorphism beyond the nav backdrop-filter, neon accents, or emoji in any content.
Don't use stock photography. The only imagery is Mari's actual portrait.
Don't create 'Challenge / Solution / Results' patterns. Showcases use 'Artifact / Process / Impact.'
Don't use border-left thicker than 2px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't introduce a dark mode. The warm ivory surface is integral to the brand identity.
Don't add testimonial carousels, newsletter signup popups, or 'Let's work together' CTAs.
Don't use the word 'project' or 'case study' in the UI. The canonical term is 'Showcase.'
Don't add decorative elements (floating shapes, background patterns, illustration). Every element earns its place or it doesn't exist.
